negative_samples: none; zero-target images quarantined because absence has not been confirmed
exact_duplicate_policy: require all members target annotations to agree within tolerance; otherwise quarantine whole group; prefer original test then val then train, lexical path tie-break
near_duplicate_policy: quarantine both endpoints of unresolved cross-split candidates; do not infer duplicate identity from score or merge labels; retain same-split candidates with unresolved status
cross_format_policy: require TXT target set to agree with same-split, same-name, file-SHA-identical COCO image target set; use COCO only as corroboration, never import extra boxes
split_policy: preserve original split of each retained image; no random resplitting
xml_policy: not used as label authority due filename and dimension problems
